targets.outcome_reasoning: The abstract states this paper’s positive outcome-reporting bias result, but does not state Pigott et al.’s own finding or an overall success verdict. The codebook’s prerequisite for an implicit comparison is not met. A study of outcome-reporting bias does not by itself establish the direction of the original result.

reasoning: A new sample of 40 dissertation/publication pairs conceptually retests Pigott et al. rather than reanalysing the original sample. Thus this is a replication despite its meta-research setting. Publisher and full-text routes did not yield the article; OpenAlex/Unpaywall listed only the inaccessible publisher PDF, Europe PMC had no record, repository/preprint search and Wayback gave no usable source. Abstract used, with the target citation transcribed from this article’s visible publisher references. Online-first 2024 and issue 2026 describe the same verified article.
